items.name: Myrmidon engineers idle count
items.description: Number of engineer agents that have been idle long enough for the ADM guard (OPE-9868).

items.name: Myrmidon XFS free percentage
items.description: Free percentage of the /srv/myrmidon-xfs filesystem (OPE-9868 / OPE-11780).

items.name: Root filesystem free percentage
items.description: Free percentage of the root (/) filesystem (OPE-11780 replaces disk-watch-board).

items.name: Kernel OOM killer log monitor
items.description: Detects cgroup and kernel OOM-killer invocations in kernel log (OPE-11780 replaces oom-watch).

items.name: vm-core build cache directory size
items.description: Monitors build cache accumulation on vm-core where builds are forbidden (OPE-11780 replaces vmcore-buildcache-guard).

items.name: Systemd failed units count
items.description: Monitors failed systemd service and timer units (OPE-11780 replaces vmcore-timers-watch).

items.name: Zabbix agent availability ping
items.description: Native agent ping replacing watchdog of watchdogs (OPE-11780 replaces vmcore-stub-watch).

triggers.name: Myrmidon: at least 3 engineers idle
triggers.operatorAction: ADM reviews the idle queue; no host script or automatic remediation is invoked.
triggers.description: Raised when the idle engineer count is greater than or equal to 3.

triggers.name: Myrmidon: /srv/myrmidon-xfs free space below 15%
triggers.operatorAction: ADM investigates capacity and schedules remediation; no deletion or host script is invoked.
triggers.description: Raised when /srv/myrmidon-xfs has less than 15 percent free space (OPE-9868).

triggers.name: Myrmidon: /srv/myrmidon-xfs free space below 10%
triggers.operatorAction: ADM immediate capacity remediation; replaces disk-watch-board.sh per Alex 10% threshold rule.
triggers.description: Raised when /srv/myrmidon-xfs free space falls below 10 percent (OPE-11780).

triggers.name: Myrmidon: root (/) free space below 10%
triggers.operatorAction: ADM immediate root capacity remediation; replaces disk-watch-board.sh per Alex 10% threshold rule.
triggers.description: Raised when root filesystem free space falls below 10 percent (OPE-11780).

triggers.name: Myrmidon vm-core: kernel OOM-killer invoked
triggers.operatorAction: ADM investigates which process or cgroup was terminated by kernel OOM; replaces oom-watch.sh.
triggers.description: Raised when kernel log records an OOM-killer event (OPE-11780).

triggers.name: Myrmidon vm-core: build cache detected on host (builds forbidden on vm-core)
triggers.operatorAction: ADM checks for unauthorized build execution on vm-core and stops build tasks (builds belong exclusively on build-vps); replaces vmcore-buildcache-guard.sh.
triggers.description: Raised when build cache directory exceeds 1GB on vm-core (OPE-11780).

triggers.name: Myrmidon vm-core: systemd unit or timer failure detected
triggers.operatorAction: ADM checks failed systemd units on vm-core via systemctl --failed; replaces vmcore-timers-watch.sh.
triggers.description: Raised when systemd has one or more failed units (OPE-11780).

triggers.name: Myrmidon vm-core: Zabbix agent unreachable (monitoring watchdog)
triggers.operatorAction: ADM verifies zabbix-agent service on vm-core; replaces vmcore-stub-watch.sh.
triggers.description: Raised when Zabbix agent fails to report for 3 minutes (OPE-11780).

decommissionTargets.function: Disk pressure monitoring with board notification
Prunes build cache on vm-core (builds forbidden on host)
